items.text: Arizona QB (uncertain): Gardner Minshew on season-ending IR. Carson Beck (back spasms) 'day to day'; Josh Johnson started Wk11 and is 'on deck' vs WAS. No starter named - Beck could reclaim the job if he practices.
Arizona (early week): out for season - WR Michael Wilson (neck), WR Kendrick Bourne, WR Jalen Brooks. IR - RB Jeremiyah Love, S Andrew Wingard. DC Nick Rallis fired Monday.

Washington (early week, short week after MNF win): QB Jayden Daniels hurt his left (non-throwing) hand vs CIN but stayed in; watch Wednesday's report. RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt activated from IR. WR Terry McLaurin out for season.
